Telemedicine Services
Expert Care for Your Pet, Anytime, Anywhere
At Veterinary Cancer Concierge Services, we understand the challenges and emotional stress that come with a cancer diagnosis for your beloved pet. Our telemedicine services are designed to provide you with convenient, compassionate, and expert care, no matter where you are. Telemedicine appointments can be scheduled in a timely manner and completed in the comfort of your own home, at work, or wherever is most convenient for you. Hearing about your pet’s cancer diagnosis and the treatment options available can be very overwhelming. The option for a telemedicine appointment allows you to digest all of this information without the added stress of bringing your pet into a hospital.
Each telemedicine appointment includes a discussion with one of our oncology specialists, as well as a written summary of your pet’s history, test results, diagnosis, and recommendations. This can be done using video conferencing or via a phone call, depending on your preference and what is easier for you.
Services Offered
Medical Oncology Telemedicine Consultations
Radiation Oncology Telemedicine Consultations
Palliative Care and Pain Management Telemedicine Consultations
Recheck and Follow-up Telemedicine Appointments
Telemedicine:
Consult with specialists (Medical Oncology, Radiation Oncology, Palliative Care) from the comfort of your home.
Diagnostics:
Bloodwork: Assess overall health and screen for diseases.
Urine testing: Analyze for infections and other issues.
Imaging: X-rays & point-of-care ultrasounds for quick evaluations.
Treatment Options:
Chemotherapy: Injectable, oral, and metronomic options for targeted treatment.
Advanced Therapies: Explore targeted therapy & immunotherapy.
Pain Management: Ensure your pet’s comfort with pain management strategies.
Hospice Care and In-Home Euthanasia:
We offer end-of-life care as well as in-home euthanasia for our current patients. This allows the patient to have a peaceful passing in the familiar surroundings of their home.
Note:
Full diagnostic abdominal ultrasounds are not available in our mobile suite.
